Specification: This module models a bounded multi-producer, multi-consumer Disruptor-style ring buffer. Producers claim sequence numbers, write their claimed sequence into a shared ring buffer, and publish availability; consumers read published entries in multicast fashion so that every consumer should eventually observe every published value. The specification checks absence of producer-consumer data races via an instantiated RingBuffer module, basic typing and bounded-state constraints, and a liveness property stating that for every reader and every publishable index below the bound, eventually always: if that index is available, then the reader has that value recorded at the corresponding position in its consumption history.
TupleConstructor:
<<
  ringbuffer,
  next_sequence,
  claimed_sequence,
  published,
  read,
  consumed,
  pc
>>
ChoiceExpr:
CHOOSE min \in Range(read) :
    \A r \in Readers : min <= read[r]

CHOOSE min \in Range(claimed_sequence) :
    \A w \in Writers : min <= claimed_sequence[w]

CHOOSE max \in candidate_sequences :
        IsPublished(max) => ~ \E w \in Writers :
          /\ claimed_sequence[w] = max + 1
          /\ IsPublished(claimed_sequence[w])
